__warning: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every number in this file was lifted from the frozen design mockup at design/mockups/city.html. The mockup's own footer calls its figures illustrative. Nothing here has been researched, sourced or reconciled, every figure is tiered thin, and none of it may ever be served to a reader. It exists so the city page contract, the adapter and the components can be built and tested against the exact shape and scale of the design. Real files live in data/cities/ and must be hand-filled with provenance.

verdict.text: London rewards the right ground more than the right trade. A restaurant takes $620K here against Manchester's $380K, and its owner keeps just $2K more. Moving the same unit from Brixton to Mayfair costs another $56K a year, more than that restaurant's owner keeps. The demand is deep; what varies is the price of standing in front of it.
